transcript:
Jordan: Heads-up, Support escalated a P0 — several customers seeing p95/p99 regressions and intermittent 504s on generate/chat endpoints starting around 04:05 UTC. Customers: bytechat, assistly, helpflow.

Support Bot: Ticket INC-5110 opened and linked to observability graphs and a customer repro. Priority: P0.

Nate: Looking at the metrics: p50 stable, p95 jumped from ~180ms -> ~900ms, p99 from ~400ms -> ~1.6s. Top traces funnel to shard runtime-kv-07.

Priya: I see a correlated spike in prefix cache activity: prefix_cache.sets jumped x12 and evictions likewise. hit_rate dropped from ~91% -> 39% between 03:58-04:04 UTC.

Emily: Grabbed a sample of cache key writes from runtime-kv-07 logs. Patterns look wrong, example:

```
SET prefix:chat:conversation:user:uid_8234:request=rid-0x7f12:routeHint=region-eu-az1
GET prefix:chat:conversation:user:uid_8234:request=rid-0x7f12:routeHint=region-eu-az1 miss
```

The request id and route hint are being concatenated into the cache key. That creates very high cardinality.

Xavier: That matches the new change we pushed last week to include routing hints in keys for affinity. The PR note said to normalize, but the sanitizer didn't end up in the runtime build for that shard.

Infra Bot: Feature rollout log: "route-hint-in-keys=true" enabled on runtime-kv-07 at 04:00:22 UTC (staged rollout).

Jordan: Sounds like classic cache thrash from high-cardinality keys. Quick mitigation options: (A) flip the flag off, (B) increase prefix cache TTL/entry weight temporarily, (C) add ingress rate-limiting for heavy routes, (D) patch cache_keyer to strip request-specific tokens.

Nate: We should flip the flag first since it's the least invasive. Risk small: hint was advisory. I can toggle via the console.

Priya: Doing it now — toggling `route-hint-in-keys=false` on runtime-kv-07.

Dev Bot: Feature flag update applied to runtime-kv-07 at 04:06:11 UTC. No restart required.

Emily: Post-toggle: active_keys dropping from 710k -> 180k within 4 minutes, hit_rate recovering to ~82%. Evictions trending down.

Jordan: Good. Also apply a short TTL bump so warmup doesn't hammer the backing store. Increase prefix cache TTL from 45s -> 240s for this runtime.

Infra Bot: prefix_cache.ttl set to 240s for runtime-kv-07 at 04:08:03 UTC.

Nate: After TTL bump + flag off, p95 back to ~220ms at 04:12, p99 ~360ms. Customers reporting fewer errors. We'll still push a code fix.

Priya: Root cause: the key builder concatenates route hint header without stripping ephemeral fields (request ids, trace tokens). The sanitizer test was omitted in the release candidate; the binary on runtime-kv-07 lacks the fix.

Emily: Quick patch proposed: in cache_keyer.sanitize() remove patterns like `request=rid-[0-9a-f]+`, remove bracketed trace tokens `\[0x[0-9a-f]+\]`, and only allow the canonical prefix segments. Add unit tests and a load regression harness that fails if cardinality balloons.

Xavier: Also adding a defensive throttle: if unique_key_rate(prefix) increases >150% over baseline in 5m, writes for that prefix will be denied (return a cached-miss fallback) and an alert to #oncall will fire. That buys time in case of future regressions.

Jordan: Can we capture repro steps from customers so eng can validate fix? Support, can you paste the curl loop they used?

Support Bot: Customer repro (example): create many unique session headers and flood concurrent chat calls.

```
for i in $(seq 1 80); do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -H "X-Session-Id: sess-$i" \
    -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":150}' &
done; wait
```

They noted p99 spikes after ~2 minutes of sustained concurrent requests.

Emily: I've opened PR #1973: "sanitize-route-hint-in-cache-key" with tests and a perf regression job. Requesting urgent review and deploy.

Nate: Also instrumenting a new metric: prefix_cache.unique_keys_rate and histogram top_prefix_miss_rate for diagnostics. Setting an alert: if unique_keys_rate increases >200% in 5m trigger P1.

Priya: For immediate diagnostics, I've added a temporary endpoint /debug/cache/top-prefixes that returns top 50 prefixes by miss rate (authz limited). That will help on-call triage in future incidents.

Xavier: Long-term items from the quick RCA: 
- Harden key builder to a strict whitelist; never include per-request IDs
- Adaptive TTL per prefix and weighted LRU eviction
- Pre-warm known high-volume prefixes for chat models
- Add client-side SDK docs discouraging per-request unique session headers unless necessary

Jordan: Timeline + actions for postmortem:
- Mitigations applied: flag toggled off 04:06:11 UTC, TTL bump 04:08:03 UTC
- Customers notified with status updates
- PR #1973 for sanitizer and tests (ETA 6h to review + QA)
- Metric/alert added for unique_keys_rate
- Postmortem doc + RCA sync scheduled 12:00 UTC today

Support Bot: INC-5110 updated: mitigations applied, customers notified, monitoring shows recovery. Owner: Emily. SLA impact: transient p95/p99 increases and intermittent 504s for high-concurrency customers.

Emily: Current status at 04:15 UTC: p95 ~210ms, p99 ~330ms, active_keys ~160k, eviction_rate normal. I'm running the regression harness locally against the fix now.

Jordan: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread as the incident record; include timestamps when you push the sanitizer and when the alerting lands. We'll close after RCA sync and the postmortem.

Support Bot: Noted. Follow-up actions assigned: Emily (patch & deploy), Nate (alerts + metrics), Xavier (runbook update).
